# Reporting security issues

For a vulnerability in Pocket Polish, open **Security** in this GitHub repository and select **Report a vulnerability** if available. If private reporting is unavailable, use an issue to request a private contact from the maintainer. Share technical details through that private channel.

Include the firmware version or commit, board model, relevant configuration, steps to reproduce and observed impact. Remove credentials, private device links, personal records and identifying data from any logs or screenshots. If an exposed credential is involved, revoke or rotate it with the issuing service.

For an ordinary build or course issue, see [Support](/.github/SUPPORT.md).
